rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a literal bubble of gas, whether in liquid or trapped in a solid.

example.english: You can see a bubble in this glass of soda water.
example.traditional: 你可以喺呢杯梳打水見到一粒氣泡。
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 hai2 ni1 bui1 so1 daa2 seoi2 gin3 dou2 jat1 lap1 hei3 paau1

rows.note: Use this for a speculative market or asset-price bubble, as in a real-estate bubble.

example.english: The property market bubble is about to burst.
example.traditional: 而家樓市個泡沫就快爆喇。
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 lau4 si5 go3 pou5 mut6 zau6 faai3 baau3 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a social or information bubble in which people mainly encounter views like their own.

example.english: You are always stuck in an information bubble, so you basically do not know what views are out there.
example.traditional: 你成日困喺同溫層入面，根本唔知出面有咩聲音。
example.jyutping: nei5 seng4 jat6 kwan3 hai2 tung4 wan1 cang4 jap6 min6 gan1 bun2 m4 zi1 ceot1 min6 jau5 me1 sing1 jam1

rows.note: Use this for the comfortable, sheltered bubble that keeps someone from facing unfamiliar people, ideas, or experiences.

example.english: You have to step out of your comfort bubble before you will dare try new things.
example.traditional: 你要行出舒適圈，先至敢試新嘢。
example.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 haang4 ceot1 syu1 sik1 hyun1 sin1 zi3 gam2 si3 san1 je5
